decisions.statement: The window is the unattended window rather than the trusted window.
A row somebody has already answered is passed over.
A split row is passed over.
A row claimed by more than one rule is written by no rule.
A rule that matches and reaches no category leaves the row and says why.
Why each row was left is tallied for a run to say beside the rows written.
A run may say the changes that run would make and write nothing.
A contested row leaves the run non-zero.

definition: the standing rules run over what arrived lately, without asking
